parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The device name to query.
> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.

parameters.name: FunctionBlockId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the custom module in the Thing Specification Language model. The identifier is unique within the product.

If you do not specify this parameter, the data of the default module is queried.

parameters.name: Identifier
parameters.description:
The list of identifiers of the properties whose desired values you want to query.

You can view the property identifiers in the feature definition of the product to which the device belongs in the console.

- You can specify up to 10 identifiers in a single call.
- You cannot specify duplicate property identifiers.
- If you do not specify this parameter, the desired values of all properties of the device are returned.

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The device ID. The globally unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device.
> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** is a globally unique identifier of a device, and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.
> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
